name: Nexeridine
summary: Nexeridine is an opioid analgesic with a similar structure to those of pethidine and tramadol. It was synthesized and assayed in 1975 but was never marketed. The active isomer is (1R,2S)-1-[(2R)-1-(dimethylamino)-2-propanyl]-2-phenylcyclohexyl acetate.

summaryZh: 奈西利定（英語：nexeridine）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C19H29NO2，結構上與曲馬多和哌替啶類似，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥，1975年首次合成，從未上市銷售。
